<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p></ix:continuation></ix:continuation><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000477" name="us-gaap:SubordinatedBorrowingsDisclosureTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001642081_20200101_20201231" escape="true" continuedAt="F_000477_dcnt_025e714e-ae3b-4cf0-8eb9-f5da79623ca3">
<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13. SUBORDINATED DEBT</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Junior Subordinated Debentures</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.67%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On January 1, 2015, the Company acquired F&#38;M Bancshares and assumed Farmers &#38; Merchants Capital Trust II and Farmers &#38; Merchants Capital Trust III with an aggregate original principal amount of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001943" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_abtxFmBancsharesIncMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapJuniorSubordinatedDebtMember_20201231" decimals="-5" scale="6">11.3</ix:nonFraction> million and a current carrying value of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001944" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_abtxFmBancsharesIncMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapJuniorSubordinatedDebtMember_20201231" decimals="-5" scale="6">9.6</ix:nonFraction> million at December&#160;31, 2020. At acquisition, the Company recorded a discount of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001945" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscount" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_abtxFmBancsharesIncMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapJuniorSubordinatedDebtMember_20150101" decimals="-5" scale="6">2.5</ix:nonFraction> million on the debentures. The difference between the carrying value and contractual balance will be recognized as a yield adjustment over the remaining term for the debentures. Each of the trusts is a capital or statutory business trust organized for the sole purpose of issuing trust securities and investing the proceeds in the Company&#8217;s junior subordinated debentures. The preferred trust securities of each trust represent preferred beneficial interests in the assets of the respective trusts and are subject to mandatory redemption upon payment of the junior subordinated debentures held by the trust. The common securities of each trust are wholly owned by the Company. Each trust&#8217;s ability to pay amounts due on the trust preferred securities is solely dependent upon the Company making payment on the related junior subordinated debentures. The debentures, which are the only assets of each trust, are subordinate and junior in right of payment to all of the Company&#8217;s present and future senior indebtedness. The Company has fully and unconditionally guaranteed each trust&#8217;s obligations under the trust securities issued by such trust to the extent not paid or made by each trust, provided such trust has funds available for such obligations. The junior subordinated debentures are included in Tier 1 capital under current regulatory guidelines and interpretations.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.67%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Under the provisions of each issue of the debentures, the Company has the right to defer payment of interest on the debentures at any time, or from time to time, for periods not exceeding <ix:nonNumeric id="F_001946" name="abtx:DebenturesPeriodOverWhichTheCompanyMayDeferInterestPayments" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapBusinessAcquisitionAxis_abtxFmBancsharesIncMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapJuniorSubordinatedDebtMember_20200101_20201231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">five years</ix:nonNumeric>. If interest payments on either issue of the debentures are deferred, the distributions on the applicable trust preferred securities and common securities will also be deferred.</p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000556" name="us-gaap:ScheduleOfSubordinatedBorrowingTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001642081_20200101_20201231" escape="true">

<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">ALLEGIANCE BANCSHARES, INC.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p><ix:continuation id="F_000477_dcnt_025e714e-ae3b-4cf0-8eb9-f5da79623ca3">
<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Subordinated Notes</span></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.67%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In December 2017, the Bank completed the issuance, through a private placement, of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001959" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapDebtInstrumentAxis_abtxFixedtoFloatingRateSubordinatedNotesMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapSubordinatedDebtMember_20171231" decimals="-5" scale="6">40.0</ix:nonFraction> million aggregate principal amount of Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes (the "Notes") due December 15, 2027. The Notes were issued at a price equal to <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_001960" name="abtx:DebtInstrumentIssuancePricePercentage" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapDebtInstrumentAxis_abtxFixedtoFloatingRateSubordinatedNotesMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapSubordinatedDebtMember_20171231" decimals="INF" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal amount, resulting in net proceeds to the Bank of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001961" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapDebtInstrumentAxis_abtxFixedtoFloatingRateSubordinatedNotesMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapSubordinatedDebtMember_20171201_20171231" decimals="-5" scale="6">39.4</ix:nonFraction> million. The Bank used the net proceeds from the offering to support its growth and for general corporate purposes. The Notes are intended to qualify as Tier 2 capital for bank regulatory purposes.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.67%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Notes bear a fixed interest rate of <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_001962" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapDebtInstrumentAxis_abtxFixedtoFloatingRateSubordinatedNotesMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapSubordinatedDebtMember_20171231" decimals="INF" scale="-2">5.25</ix:nonFraction>% per annum until (but excluding) December 15, 2022, payable semi-annually in arrears. From December 15, 2022, the Notes will bear a floating rate of interest equal to 3-Month LIBOR + <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_001964" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapDebtInstrumentAxis_abtxFixedtoFloatingRateSubordinatedNotesMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapSubordinatedDebtMember_us-gaapVariableRateAxis_us-gaapLondonInterbankOfferedRateLIBORMember_20171201_20171231" decimals="INF" scale="-2">3.03</ix:nonFraction>% until the Notes mature on December 15, 2027, or such earlier redemption date, payable quarterly in arrears. The Notes will be redeemable by the Bank, in whole or in part, on or after December 15, 2022 or, in whole but not in part, upon the occurrence of certain specified tax events, capital events or investment company events. Any redemption will be at a redemption price equal to <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_001963" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentRedemptionPricePercentage" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapDebtInstrumentAxis_abtxFixedtoFloatingRateSubordinatedNotesMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapSubordinatedDebtMember_20171201_20171231" decimals="INF" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal amount of Notes being redeemed, plus accrued and unpaid interest, and will be subject to, and require, prior regulatory approval. The Notes are not subject to redemption at the option of the holders.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.67%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In September 2019, the Company completed the issuance of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001965" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapDebtInstrumentAxis_abtxFixedtoFloatingRateSubordinatedNotesMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapSubordinatedDebtMember_20190930" decimals="-5" scale="6">60.0</ix:nonFraction> million aggregate principal amount of Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes (the "Company Notes") due October 1, 2029. The Company Notes were issued at a price equal to <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_001966" name="abtx:DebtInstrumentIssuancePricePercentage" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapDebtInstrumentAxis_abtxFixedtoFloatingRateSubordinatedNotesMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapSubordinatedDebtMember_20190930" decimals="INF" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal amount, resulting in net proceeds to the Company of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001967" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapDebtInstrumentAxis_abtxFixedtoFloatingRateSubordinatedNotesMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapSubordinatedDebtMember_20190901_20190930" decimals="-5" scale="6">58.6</ix:nonFraction> million. </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.67%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company Notes bear a fixed interest rate of <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_001968" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapDebtInstrumentAxis_abtxFixedtoFloatingRateSubordinatedNotesMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapSubordinatedDebtMember_20190930" decimals="INF" scale="-2">4.70</ix:nonFraction>% per annum until (but excluding) October 1, 2024, payable semi-annually in arrears on April&#160;1 and October&#160;1, commencing on April&#160;1, 2020. Thereafter, from October&#160;1, 2024 through the maturity date, October&#160;1, 2029, or earlier redemption date, the Company Notes will bear interest at a floating rate equal to the then-current three-month LIBOR, plus 313 basis points (<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_001970" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapDebtInstrumentAxis_abtxFixedtoFloatingRateSubordinatedNotesMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapSubordinatedDebtMember_us-gaapVariableRateAxis_us-gaapLondonInterbankOfferedRateLIBORMember_20190901_20190930" decimals="INF" scale="-2">3.13</ix:nonFraction>%) for each quarterly interest period (subject to certain provisions set forth under &#8220;Description of the Notes&#8212;Interest Rates and Interest Payment Dates&#8221; included in the Prospectus Supplement), payable quarterly in arrears on January&#160;1, April&#160;1, July&#160;1 and October&#160;1 of each year. Any redemption will be at a redemption price equal to <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_001969" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentRedemptionPricePercentage" contextRef="C_0001642081_us-gaapDebtInstrumentAxis_abtxFixedtoFloatingRateSubordinatedNotesMember_us-gaapLongtermDebtTypeAxis_us-gaapSubordinatedDebtMember_20190901_20190930" decimals="INF" scale="-2">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal amount of Company Notes being redeemed, plus accrued and unpaid interest, and will be subject to, and require, prior regulatory approval. The Company Notes are not subject to redemption at the option of the holders.</p></ix:continuation><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000478" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxDisclosureTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001642081_20200101_20201231" escape="true" continuedAt="F_000478_dcnt_a8f1d309-5d9d-4d65-838c-1cc6c40eab2a">

<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">401(k) benefit plan</p>

<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Employee Stock Purchase Plan</p>

<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">17. OFF-BALANCE SHEET ARRANGEMENTS, COMMITMENTS AND CONTINGENCIES</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.67%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the normal course of business, the Company enters into various transactions, which, in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States are not included in the Company&#8217;s consolidated balance sheets. The Company enters into these transactions to meet the financing needs of its customers. These transactions include commitments to extend credit and standby and commercial letters of credit, which involve to varying degrees elements of credit risk and interest rate risk in excess of the amounts recognized in the consolidated balance sheets. The Company uses the same credit policies in making commitments and conditional obligations as it does for on balance sheet instruments.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Commitments to Extend Credit</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.67%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Commitments to extend credit are agreements to lend to a customer as long as there is no violation of any condition established in the contract. Commitments generally have fixed expiration dates or other termination clauses and may require payment of a fee. Since many of the commitments are expected to expire without being fully drawn upon, the total commitment amounts disclosed do not necessarily represent future cash funding requirements. The Company evaluates each customer&#8217;s creditworthiness on a case-by-case basis. The Company minimizes its exposure to loss under these commitments by subjecting them to credit approval and monitoring procedures. Management assesses the credit risk associated with certain commitments to extend credit in determining the level of the allowance for credit losses. The amount and type of collateral, if deemed necessary by the Company upon extension of credit, is based on management&#8217;s credit evaluation of the customer.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Standby Letters of Credit</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.67%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Standby letters of credit are written conditional commitments issued by the Company to guarantee the performance of a customer to a third party. In the event of nonperformance by the customer, the Company has the rights to the underlying collateral. The credit risk to the Company in issuing letters of credit is essentially the same as that involved in extending loan facilities to its customers. The Company&#8217;s policy for obtaining collateral, and the nature of such collateral, is essentially the same as that involved in making commitments to extend credit.</p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000563" name="us-gaap:ScheduleOfFairValueOffBalanceSheetRisksTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001642081_20200101_20201231" escape="true">

As of December&#160;31, 2020, the fixed rate loan commitments have interest rates ranging from <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_002127" name="abtx:OffBalanceSheetFixedRateLoanCommitmentsInterestRate" contextRef="C_0001642081_srtRangeAxis_srtMinimumMember_20201231" decimals="INF" scale="-2">1.20</ix:nonFraction>% to <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_002128" name="abtx:OffBalanceSheetFixedRateLoanCommitmentsInterestRate" contextRef="C_0001642081_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_20201231" decimals="INF" scale="-2">18.00</ix:nonFraction>% with a weighted average maturity and rate of <ix:nonNumeric id="F_002126" name="abtx:OffBalanceSheetFixedRateLoanCommitmentsWeightedAverageMaturity" contextRef="C_0001642081_20200101_20201231" format="ixt-sec:duryear">3.53</ix:nonNumeric> years and <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_002129" name="abtx:OffBalanceSheetFixedRateLoanCommitmentsInterestRate" contextRef="C_0001642081_srtRangeAxis_srtWeightedAverageMember_20201231" decimals="4" scale="-2">5.13</ix:nonFraction>%, respectively.</p></ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000482" name="us-gaap:RegulatoryCapitalRequirementsUnderBankingRegulationsTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001642081_20200101_20201231" escape="true" continuedAt="F_000482_dcnt_e9536ca0-30a4-4443-ad82-9e326721c3f6">
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">18. REGULATORY CAPITAL MATTERS</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.67%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company and the Bank are subject to various regulatory capital requirements administered by the federal banking agencies. Capital adequacy guidelines and, additionally for banks, prompt corrective action regulations involve quantitative measures of assets, liabilities and certain off balance sheet items calculated under regulatory accounting practices. Capital amounts and classifications are also subject to qualitative judgments by regulators about components, risk weightings and other factors. Failure to meet minimum capital requirements can initiate actions by regulators that, if undertaken, could have a direct material effect on the Company&#8217;s consolidated financial statements. Management believes as of December&#160;31, 2020 and 2019, the Company and the Bank met all capital adequacy requirements to which they were subject. </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.67%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Prompt corrective action regulations provide five classifications: well capitalized, adequately capitalized, undercapitalized, significantly undercapitalized and critically undercapitalized, although these terms are not used to represent overall financial </p></ix:nonNumeric>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">118</p>

<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p><ix:continuation id="F_000482_dcnt_e9536ca0-30a4-4443-ad82-9e326721c3f6">
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">condition. If adequately capitalized, regulatory approval is required to accept brokered deposits. If undercapitalized, capital distributions are limited as is asset growth and expansion, and capital restoration plans are required. At </span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">year-end</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> 20</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">20</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> and 201</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">9</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">, the most recent regulatory notifications categorized the Bank as well capitalized under the regulatory framework for prompt corrective action. There are no conditions or events since that notification that management believes have changed the institution&#8217;s category.</span><span style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> </span></p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000564" name="us-gaap:ScheduleOfComplianceWithRegulatoryCapitalRequirementsUnderBankingRegulationsTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001642081_20200101_20201231" escape="true">

<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Dividend Restrictions</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.67%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Allegiance's principal source of funds for dividend payments is dividends received from the Bank. Banking regulations limit the amount of dividends that may be paid without prior approval of regulatory agencies. In addition, Allegiance's credit agreement with another financial institution also limits its ability to pay dividends. Under applicable banking regulations, the amount of dividends that may be paid by the Bank in any calendar year is limited to the current year&#8217;s net profits combined with the retained net profits of the preceding two years, subject to the capital requirements described above.</p></ix:continuation><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000483" name="us-gaap:EarningsPerShareTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001642081_20200101_20201231" escape="true" continuedAt="F_000483_dcnt_e41ef869-4974-4f42-8d13-3ca28a76273a">

<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1</span><span style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">9</span><span style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">. <p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:6.67%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Diluted earnings per common share is computed using the weighted-average number of common shares determined for the basic earnings per common share computation plus the potential dilution that could occur if securities or other contracts to issue common stock were exercised or converted into common stock using the treasury stock method. Outstanding stock options and PSUs issued by the Company represent the only dilutive effect reflected in diluted weighted average shares. <ix:nonNumeric id="F_000565" name="us-gaap:ScheduleOfEarningsPerShareBasicAndDilutedTableTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001642081_20200101_20201231" escape="true" continuedAt="F_000565_cnt_1">Common shares issuable under restricted stock awards are considered outstanding at the date of grant and are accounted for as participating securities and included in basic and diluted weighted average common shares outstanding</ix:nonNumeric>.</p>
